fixture_purpose: Demonstrates that the same idempotency_key with a different canonical request fingerprint returns -32044 idempotency_conflict without mutating execution state except the rate-limited conflict_count audit increment.

evidence.mechanism: BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction checks idempotency_scope+idempotency_key before insert. If the fingerprint differs, increments conflict_count on the matched row and returns AtomicAdmissionOutcome::IdempotencyConflict. The MCP handler maps this to error code -32044 with failure_reason=idempotency_conflict.
evidence.hold_predicate_prevented: same scope+key with different fingerprint now always returns -32044 and never mutates execution state beyond the conflict_count audit increment (which is itself a durable audit row, not a new continuation)
